General purpose knives and machine tools can be quite satisfactorily sharpened with a stone abrasive, as you have been doing.

The next level after a stone is wet and dry sand paper, which will provide a different finnish on the tool surface. This finnish ( if done correctly) will allow you to have the same wedge angle but with a lower friction.
